book.name: 2 Abhakʉrintʉ
book.title: Ɨnyarʉbha ya kabhɨrɨ ya Paaurʉ kwa Abhakʉrintʉ

content: Mmbe, inyɨ Paaurʉ nɨrarorekana mʉnyʉʉhu hanʉ nɨkʉbha hamwɨmwɨ na niimwɨ, nawe mʉkararu hanʉ nɨkʉbha kore na niimwɨ. Nawe nangʉ, nɨrabhiisasaama kwa bhʉnyʉʉhu nʉ ʉbhʉzʉmu bhwa Kiriisitʉ.

Nɨrabhasabha, mʉtagirya nɨbhɨ nʉ ʉbhʉkararu hanʉ niriizɨ kwa niimwɨ. Nɨragambabhu, konzobhooro nɨɨzɨ nɨratʉra kʉbha mʉkararu kʉbhaatʉ bhʉʉsi bhanʉ bhakwiseega kʉbha itwɨ turiikara ncha abhaatʉ abhandɨ bha mʉʉsɨ yɨnʉ.
Nangabha turiikara kʉʉsɨ kʉnʉ, tʉtakwitana riihɨ ncha abhaatʉ bha kʉʉsɨ kʉnʉ.
Ebheseme bhyɨtʉ bhya riihɨ bhɨtarɨ bhɨnʉ abhaatʉ bhakohokerya kʉʉsɨ kʉnʉ, nawe bhɨna amanaga ga Mungu, na bhɨragwisha rigoobhe ryu umubhisa ryʉsi.
Tʉrasarya amiisɨɨgi gʉʉsi gʉ ʉrʉrɨmɨ na amangʼana gʉʉsi gu ukwikumya ganʉ gakorecha abhaatʉ komenya Mungu. Na tʉragwata amiisɨɨgi gʉʉsi, korereke giitegeerere Kiriisitʉ.
Na hanʉ mʉkʉbha mumwigwirɨ, itwɨ tʉrabha tʉmarirɨ kʉtɨnɨra amangʼana gʉʉsi ganʉ gatarɨ gu ubhwigwa.
Morore ganʉ garɨ mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa amɨɨsʉ gaanyu! Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akwirora ewe nɨ‑wa Kiriisitʉ, ahiitɨ na niitwɨ nɨ‑bha Kiriisitʉ, nche ewe.
Nʉʉrʉ niriikumya kʉhɨta ekerengo igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉnaja bhʉnʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ atʉhɨɨrɨ, tʉtʉrɨ kʉbhanaja na ɨtarɨ kʉbhasarya, kwikɨ nɨtakorora zɨsʉni igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉnaja bhuyo.
Nɨtakwenda nerorekanɨ kwa niimwɨ kʉbha, nereenda kʉbhakanga kʉhɨtɨra zɨnyarʉbha zaanɨ.
Nɨragambabhu, kʉ kʉbha bharabhuga, “Zɨnyarʉbha za Paaurʉ zɨna amangʼana maritʉ, na amangʼana amahaari. Nawe hanʉ akʉbha hamwɨmwɨ na niitwɨ ataana amanaga, na amangʼana gaazɨ garabha gataana bhwera.”
Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ aabhugirɨ, amenye kʉbha, ganʉ tʉkwandɨka mʉzɨnyarʉbha tore kore, nego toreekore hanʉ tʉkʉbha na niimwɨ.
Itwɨ tʉtakwirɨngʼaanʼya nʉʉrʉ hasuuhu na abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakwikumya hamwɨ kwituubhanʼya nabhʉ. Nawe bhatɨɨzɨ ryʉryʉsi kʉ kʉbha bhariirɨngʼaanʼya abheene kobheene na kwituubhanʼya abheene kobheene.
Nawe itwɨ tʉtakwikumya kʉkɨra ekerengo chɨtʉ. Nawe turiikumya igʉrʉ we ekerengo che emeremo gɨnʉ Mungu atʉhɨɨrɨ. Emeremo giyo nejo gɨnʉ tokokora nʉʉrʉ kwa niimwɨ.
Tʉtakwikumya kʉkɨra ekerengo che emeremo jɨtʉ, chɨmbu yangabhɨɨrɨ tʉkɨɨrɨ kuhika kwa niimwɨ. Nawe itwɨ twarɨ bhe embere kʉbhareetera Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu igʉrʉ wa Kiriisitʉ.

Na tʉtakwikumya igʉrʉ we emeremo ja abhaatʉ abhandɨ, emeremo gɨnʉ itwɨ tʉtahɨɨrwɨ. Nawe turiisega kʉbha, chɨmbu ubhwisirirya bhwanyu bhokongʼeha kʉkʉra, nɨmbu emeremo jɨtʉ gatɨ waanyu gɨkʉbha gɨrakʉra.
Hayo neho tʉkʉtʉra kurwaza Ɨngʼana Ɨnzʉmu zɨɨsɨ ɨzɨndɨ ɨnʉ amangʼana gayo gakɨɨrɨ kʉraarikwa. Na tʉtakwikumya igʉrʉ we emeremo gɨnʉ jakʉrirwɨ na abhaatʉ ahagero ahandɨ.
Amaandɨkʉ Amarɨndu garabhuga, “Ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akwikumya, ikumyɨ igʉrʉ wʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ.”
Enzobhooro yaku nɨ‑yɨnʉ, wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akwikumya umwene atakwisiriribhwa, nawe wʉnʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ akumukumya, newe akwisiriribhwa.
